name: un-comtrade-mcp-server
description: Access UN Comtrade international merchandise and services trade statistics — country lookups, HS commodity search, bilateral trade flows, balances, rankings, and data availability — via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: UN Comtrade trade statistics via MCP — country/HS lookups, bilateral flows, balances, rankings.
interface.longDescription: Query UN Comtrade merchandise and services trade statistics. Resolve country and commodity codes, browse EBOPS service categories, page through bilateral flows, compute goods balances, and rank partners for a product or service. Check which periods a reporter has published before querying. The public preview serves up to 500 records per upstream request. A subscription key enables authenticated access subject to subscription limits. Runs over stdio or Streamable HTTP.
